spec.claim_summary: The claim encourages buying Bitcoin pullbacks of 20% or more on the view they commonly rebound to new highs.
spec.untestable_reason: No mechanical entry trigger, lookback, timeframe, or exit is stated, only general advice to buy 20% pullbacks and fear.
assumptions: Claim is general encouragement to buy fear / 20% Bitcoin pullbacks with no defined lookback, entry trigger, timeframe, or exit.
20% pullback has no reference point stated (from what high over what period) so no mechanical entry can be recovered without inventing the rule.
No exit, stop, target, or holding period is stated.
